add_namespace = COLDWAR_WM

# The story, sent to every country. Event target COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator = the country that did it.
news_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_WM.1
	title = COLDWAR_WM.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_WM.1.d
	picture = GFX_news_event_war
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = { # condemn
		name = COLDWAR_WM.1.a
		trigger = { NOT = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator } }
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_WM.1 option a"
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator modifier = COLDWAR_WM_condemned }
		add_stability = 0.01
	}
	option = { # look away
		name = COLDWAR_WM.1.b
		trigger = { NOT = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator } }
		ai_chance = { base = 3 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_WM.1 option b"
	}
	option = { # stand by an ally
		name = COLDWAR_WM.1.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator }
			is_in_faction_with = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_WM.1 option c"
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator modifier = COLDWAR_WM_stood_by }
		add_war_support = -0.02
	}
	option = { # the perpetrator
		name = COLDWAR_WM.1.e
		trigger = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_WM.1 option e"
	}
}

# Our observers saw a crime. ROOT = observer. Targets are read back from the observer's variables.
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_OBS.1
	title = COLDWAR_OBS.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_OBS.1.d
	picture = GFX_news_event_war
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			var:COLDWAR_OBS_seen_state = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_OBS_state }
			var:COLDWAR_OBS_seen_host = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_OBS_host }
			var:COLDWAR_OBS_seen_perp = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_OBS_perp }
		}
	}

	option = { # publish
		name = COLDWAR_OBS.1.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_OBS.1 option a"
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:COLDWAR_OBS_perp = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_evidence > 0 } } }
			save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_verifier
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_verified = 1 }
			event_target:COLDWAR_OBS_perp = {
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_story_src = ROOT.COLDWAR_OBS_seen_state }
				COLDWAR_WM_story_breaks = yes
			}
		}
		else = { custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS.1.a_already }
	}
	option = { # keep silent
		name = COLDWAR_OBS.1.b
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_OBS.1 option b"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS.1.b_tt
		event_target:COLDWAR_OBS_perp = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_WM_silent value = PREV } } }
				add_to_array = { COLDWAR_WM_silent = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
